newsitem.title: USA: Vectra Banking says to issue securities.
newsitem.headline: Vectra Banking says to issue securities.

text.p: Vectra Banking Corp and its subsidiary VBC Capital I said on Monday they would issue 700,000 cumulative capital securities at $25 per capital security, with an annual yield of 9.50 percent.
Dain Bosworth Inc and Howe Barnes Investments Inc will underwrite the offering, the company said.
It added that the securities will trade on the Nasdaq National Market under the ticker symbol VTRA.

"Under this structure, the proceeds from the sale of the capital securities will be used to purchase junior subordinated debentures issued by Vectra," the company said. It added that the securities are callable after five years and mature on April 30, 2027.
Vectra said it will use approximately $8.3 million of the net proceeds to redeem its outstanding $0.95 Series A cumulative preferred stock.
Vectra Banking Corp is an independent bank holding company based in Colorado. VBC Capital I is a Delaware business trust and wholly owned subsidiary of Vectra.
